name: Deaden Attack
body:
Discipline metacreativity
Level marksman 1, psychic warrior 1

MANIFESTING

Display: material
Manifesting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: 1 weapon
Duration: 1 rnd./lvl.
Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Power Resistance: Yes; see text
Power Points: 1

DESCRIPTION

You coat a single manufactured weapon within range in a sheen of springy ectoplasm. The manufactured weapon deals nonlethal damage instead of lethal damage for the duration of the effect. Ranged weapons transmit this effect to ammunition fired.

If you attempt to manifest this power on an attended weapon not in your possession, the owner may attempt a Will save to resist the effect.
